note: ORPHAN Pro 13:11 — wealth gained hastily will dwindle, but who gathers little by little increases it.

dims.v: get-rich haste — wealth grabbed quickly, which dwindles away
the wealth gained hastily that dwindles — riches grabbed by shortcut and haste, which have no root and melt away, against the patient gathering that grows
the patient increase it is set against (263141)
set against the little-by-little gathering that lasts
hon (wealth) — 'WEALTH gained hastily will dwindle' (13:11); riches got by haste and shortcut have no staying power. What is grabbed quickly slips away quickly (cf 20:21; 28:22).
patient diligence — steady accumulation that grows and lasts
the gathering little by little that increases wealth — the patient, steady diligence that builds slowly and surely, the opposite of the haste that dwindles
the hasty gain it is set against (263135)
set against the hastily-grabbed wealth that dwindles
rabah (increase) — 'but whoever gathers little by little will INCREASE it' (13:11); patient, steady accumulation lasts where haste fails. Diligence over time builds what haste cannot hold.
